definitions: Professional activities performed in a state of distraction-free concentration that push your cognitive capabilities to their limit. These efforts create new value, improve your skill, and are hard to replicate.
Work that requires intense focus and concentration, often leading to significant progress or innovation.
examples: He scheduled a block of time for deep work to finish the report.
To achieve mastery, one must engage in regular deep work.
Minimizing distractions is crucial for effective deep work.
